remarks: Welcome to 15013 Kingsdale Avenue, a beautifully remodeled 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom single-family home offering 2,165 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space in the heart of Lawndale. This stunning residence has been extensively updated with modern finishes and quality upgrades throughout, including a brand-new kitchen, beautifully renovated bathrooms, new windows, new roof, upgraded electrical panel, and new flooring. At the heart of the home is a gorgeous chef’s kitchen designed for both everyday living and entertaining, seamlessly connecting to a spacious living room with direct access to the rear yard, creating the perfect indoor-outdoor flow.
